summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting its Q1 2026 financial and operating results. The filing covers routine quarterly updates including cash position, gold sales, project financing draw, and operational progress at the Cariboo Gold Project. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is disclosed. The press release is a standard earnings report with no material corporate transaction.
